verdicts.reason: Both keep the original's centred stack, but they move the decorative circles inward. The teal circle no longer bleeds off the edge: the 'GLACIER' wordmark sits on its edge and the can sits half over it. The legal line overlaps the light-blue circle and is tiny at this size. A also pushes the whole stack up, so legal ends around y=665 and leaves a dead band at the bottom while the top half feels crowded. B spaces the logo, can, headline, CTA and legal more evenly down the canvas and keeps the legal near the bottom margin, as in the original.
